title: Pipeline
subtitle: Deals by stage, with ageing, value and AI predictions.

empty.title: No deals in your pipeline yet
empty.body: Add a lead by typing or pasting a client's message, or import a list. Every lead shows up here as a deal.

move.title: Move to…
move.denied: You can't move {{name}}: it isn't one of your deals.
move.bookVisit: {{name}} has no site visit booked yet. Book it now.
move.cancelled: Move cancelled. The deal stays where it was.

card.valueTip: Deal value (or the top of the budget until a property is chosen)
card.predictionTip: AI prediction: {{pct}}% chance to convert, from the stage and the lead score ({{score}}).
card.stalledTip: AI: stalled for {{days}} days, more than twice the {{target}}-day target for this stage.

dnd.instructions: To move a deal, press Space to pick it up. Use the arrow keys to choose a stage, then press Space again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
dnd.cancel: Move cancelled. {{name}} stays where it was.

kpi.forecastHint: Each deal's value × its predicted chance to convert
kpi.forecastRing: Share of open value expected to convert
kpi.stalledHint: Over 2× the stage target. Click to show only these.
kpi.stalledOn: Showing stalled deals only. Click to show all.

ai.title: Stalled deals
ai.failed: The assistant couldn't read the pipeline. Try again.
ai.none: No stalled deals. Every open deal is within twice its stage target.
ai.nextTip: The assistant's next best action for this lead
ai.needsOwner: Assign this lead first, then plan the follow-up.
ai.more_one: {{count}} more stalled deal. Turn on "Stalled only" to see it.
ai.more_other: {{count}} more stalled deals. Turn on "Stalled only" to see them.

advice.firstCall: Make the first call now: new leads go cold within hours.
advice.qualify: Call to confirm budget, timeline and who decides, then move to Qualified.
advice.bookVisit: Share the best match and book a site visit this week.
advice.confirmVisit: Confirm the visit on WhatsApp, or reschedule it.
advice.postVisitCall: Call for feedback on the visit and ask what would make them book.
advice.closeGap: Meet to close the price gap: bring the payment plan and loan options.
advice.collectDocs: Collect the booking documents and set the agreement date.

assistant.title: Pipeline assistant
assistant.label: Ask the pipeline assistant
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Move Priya Sharma to negotiation

dialog.bookedHint: Booking marks the property as Booked, creates the client record and a documents task.
dialog.lostHint: Open tasks and future visits for this lead are cancelled.
dialog.convertedHint: Marks the deal as won: the client becomes Converted and the property Sold.
